$description: Q145.Y reference spec .design-library/youtube-ref/README.md (headless, signed out, 1280/1440/720, light and dark). Sources are capture ids: H home, S search, G guide open, C channel grid, T hashtag grid, W watch; L light, D dark. Type: Roboto (OFL) from the font registry, the reference's own face. Unmeasured values say so.

color.text.$description: Text primary: W-1280-L/D title, G-1280-D guide labels.

color.text-muted.$description: Meta and subscriber lines: T-1280-L/D, S-1280-L/D.

c.chip.check.$description: The on chip has no check mark; it reads by its solid fill (S-1280-L).

c.chip.edge.$description: Chips have no outline; the fill is the boundary (S-1280-L).

c.chip.fill.$description: A chip at rest: unmeasured on the chip itself; the tonal fill measured on the watch page's pills (W-1280-L/D).

color.map.chip.$description: The on chip's fill (and edge): S-1280-L #0F0F0F, S-1280-D #F1F1F1.

color.map.chip-tint.$description: The on chip is a solid fill: S-1280-L/D.

c.chip.selected-text.$description: The on chip's words: S-1280-L #F1F1F1, S-1280-D #0F0F0F.

c.button.size.$description: Every masthead and guide button is 40 high: guide 40×40, voice 40×40, settings 40×40, Sign in 104.6×40 (H-1280-L).

c.field.radius.$description: The search capsule's outer ends are fully round: box radius 40 0 0 40, button 0 40 40 0 (H-1280-L).

type.label.size.$description: Chip words 14/20 w500 (S-1280-L) and Sign in 14 w500 (H-1280-L).

type.heading-4.size.$description: A video's title in the feed 16/22 w500 (C-1280-L).

type.heading-4.weight.$description: A video's title in the feed 16/22 w500 (C-1280-L).

type.heading-4.leading.$description: A video's title in the feed 16/22: two lines are 44 high (C-1280-L).

type.body-sm.leading.$description: Meta lines and guide labels 14/20 (T-1280-L, G-1280-L).

size.icon-md.$description: Every masthead, guide and card icon is 24 (H-1280-L guide, search, mic, settings, sign-in; G-1280-L entries; T-1280-L card menu).

c.button.radius.$description: Icon buttons are round (40×40, radius 50%) and Sign in is radius 20 at 40 high (H-1280-L).

c.button.default-fill.$description: A default button is tonal: voice search fill (H-1280-L/D).

c.button.default-edge.$description: Tonal buttons have no outline (voice search, H-1280-L).

c.field.padding-inline.$description: Search text starts 16 inside the box (H-1280-L padding 0 4 0 16).

c.field.action-padding-inline.$description: The search button is 64 wide around a 24 icon (H-1280-L).

radius.md.$description: Guide entries, expanded and mini: radius 10 (G-1280-L, H-1280-L).

c.badge.size-s.$description: The length badge is 20 high (C-1280-L); icons grow to 24 here, the badge doesn't.

color.bg-overlay.$description: The drawer scrim: black at 50 %, reads #7F7F7F on white (G-1280-L); dark unmeasured, same scrim.
